request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only his skin colour: the face, ears, chest, belly, arms, hands, legs and feet become a deeper, somewhat darker, true goblin green like moss, with a darker green shadow tone; clearly green, not yellow, not olive and not black. Keep everything else exactly the same: the orange-brown leather cap, crossed straps and loincloth, the belt, wrist bands, dagger, eyes, teeth, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
